test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
What will come at the place of (?)

PHOBIA : FEAR :: AMNESIA : ?
solution:
The logic followed here is :

**"Phobia"** means an extreme **"Fear"**.

Similarly,

**"Amnesia"** means **"Forgetfulness"** or loss of memory.

Hence, the correct answer is **"option (2)"**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
 

 **Word**
 **Meaning**
 
 

 Phobia
 Extreme fear of something
 
 

 Amnesia
 Loss of memory or forgetfulness
 
 

 Consciousness
 State of being aware
 
 

 Intelligence
 Ability to learn and understand
